rows.old_text:
<span color="#ffe398">Dreamwalk Odyssey</>
Dreamwalk Odyssey has 3 levels. To unlock the next level, clear the previous one and meet the World Level requirement.

<span color="#ffe398">Random Challenges</><span color="#ffe398"></>
Each run features one challenge from Three-school Showdown, Starlight Exploration, Festive Fire Opera, and Saepes Shadows. It changes when you complete it or automatically at 4:00 AM daily.

<span color="#ffe398">Free Chest</>
The first chest you open each day in Dreamwalk Odyssey doesn't consume Vitality. This free chest resets at 4:00 AM daily.
rows.new_text:
<span color="#ffe398">Dreamland Chronicles</>
     Dreamland Chronicles consists of 12 floors. To unlock floors 1-4 of Floating Life, you must reach the corresponding Yuan Flow level and Wave Flow Realm, and clear the previous floor. For Floating Life 5 and Transcendence 1-6, you must reach Wave Flow Realm 7 and achieve a Perfect rating on the previous floor.

<span color="#ffe398">Random Rules</>
     Weekly Secret Spells reset every Monday. The difficulty of these spells varies based on the challenge difficulty. The dungeon and its corresponding Secret Spell are randomized daily.
 
<span color="#ffe398">Random Range</>
     Three Academies Clash, Stargazing Anomalies, Festive Fire Dance, Woodland Shadows.

<span color="#ffe398">Stamina-Free Rules</>
     You get one free challenge attempt for Dreamland Chronicles daily. If successful, opening the reward chest will not consume Flowing Dew. This count refreshes at 4:00 AM daily.

<span color="#ffe398">Daily Reward Rules</>
     Complete any Dreamland level (any rating) to receive full daily rewards. Daily rewards for Transcendence 1-6 are identical.

<span color="#ffe398">Weekly Reward Rules</>
     Weekly rewards are settled at 4:00 AM every Monday based on the highest floor cleared with a Perfect rating during the previous week.

rows.old_text: Thunder rumbles in the wilderness; the giant horns rise high, summoning the lightning.
rows.new_text: Its roar is like thunder, its movement like a storm. The Thunder-Bull, which once galloped across the vast plains, harbors lightning within its massive horns.

When in bear or human form, it summons Nightmare Butterflies to grab a player and fly toward the Nightmare Rift. Teammates must shoot down the butterflies in time; otherwise, falling into the rift will trigger a devastating explosion.
The Wanshu Hammer releases three consecutive full-screen shockwaves. Before each release, it teleports to the edge of the arena, with each shockwave facing a different direction.

The Sky-Slayer Spirit returns to the arena to charge and summon five rotating constellations, while also releasing three layers of expanding ring-shaped area damage. Players must dodge the continuous ground fire while shattering the constellation nodes.
Damage from ground fire is significantly increased; even brief contact can be fatal.
The Brutal Tiger's shield durability increases significantly during its charge; the team must focus fire to break it.

After charging, the Brutal Tiger immediately leaps to the center and slams the ground repeatedly, causing a screen-wide shockwave. Only by picking up the dropped Mechanism Shield can you block it; jumping or dodging will not help.

The Halberd-Slayer Spirit's fire shield remains on the field. Four players must accurately identify and lure their respective clones into the shield while staying spread out to avoid overlapping paths.
Each player enters a cooldown after blocking with a shield. Teammates must take turns picking up shields to handle the continuous attacks from random directions.
After the Darkest Nightmare descends, the location of the Nightmare Light Platform will change randomly, making it hard to predict.
Blade-wielding small radishes appear on the sidelines to hunt down unbound players. You must lure their slashes to cut the vines and rescue your teammates.

The Wood Fence King absorbs the life force of nearby small wood fences, expanding rapidly and covering itself in impenetrable thorn armor. Bomb-throwing guards appear on the sidelines; only by picking up their fire bombs and throwing them at the King's armor can its defenses be dismantled. Otherwise, its power will grow with its size until it crushes everything.

The Bomb-Thrower's fire bombs explode shortly after landing. Players must pick them up and throw them at the Wooden Fence King within the time limit; otherwise, you will lose the critical window for armor-breaking.

The rotation speed of the starlight walls has become extremely fast, and the escape gaps vanish in an instant. The pressure of tracking the Constellation Shadows is greatly increased, posing a massive test to the team's output and coordination.
The summoned Nightmare Butterflies have significantly increased life force and are harder to defeat quickly.
The cost of holding the Nightmare Light has become heavier, and the rate of Max HP loss has accelerated sharply, forcing the team to complete the relay and escort as quickly as possible.
The Brutal Tiger leaps to the center and slams the ground repeatedly, creating spreading shockwaves. Players can jump or dodge to avoid them. Watch out for the final hit, which is a red-light skill.
The Phantom Nightmare cycles between Wolf, Bear, and Human forms, each with unique combat tactics.
The Wood Fence King uses vines to bind all players and summons Wood Fence Spear Guards to charge across the field. You must break free from the vines immediately to avoid the attacks.
The Scorching Fluff's breath turns the entire field into a sea of fire. Friendly wood fences will rise as stone pillars around the arena.

Grand Lord Botu summons a deep darkness that consumes everything. The illuminated area around the Nightmare Light Platform protects players from the darkness's continuous erosion. You must find and defeat the two Nightmare Feather Guards emerging from the darkness, seize their Nightmare Light, and successfully escort it to the platform to light it, dispelling the darkness and forcing the boss to reveal itself.
The number of stone pillars rising on the field has decreased, and they collapse faster. The team must make the most precise movement decisions under extreme time pressure.
The player holding the Nightmare Light will continuously lose Max HP. The team must take turns in a relay to escort the light to the destination.
All stone pillars will rise simultaneously, and each will collapse after bearing pressure for a moment.

When leaping to the center of the arena, the Radish King pre-plants multiple explosive radish traps. If a dragged player passes through a trap, it triggers an area explosion and leaves behind scorched earth.

All four phantom charges from the Blade-Slayer Spirit must be lured into the Halberd-Slayer Spirit's fire shield. Any mistake will result in a failed shield break, putting the team's precision and coordination to the ultimate test.
The blade-wielding small radishes are more aggressive. The team must precisely lure them to cut the vines while avoiding traps and fire zones. Any mistake could lead to casualties.

Rescued players must guide the inactive Self-Destruct Radishes on the field to ram into the Radish King, or lure it into the burning ground left behind. Only through continuous burning can its armor be dismantled; otherwise, it will remain.

The Radish King leaps to the center of the field, knocking back all players. It then blows its horn, binding three players with vines and dragging them toward itself. Players pulled to the Radish King will suffer a fatal slash.

The Small Armored Rat's HP is significantly increased, requiring higher firepower to clear quickly. Meanwhile, the lure range of the nuts shrinks extremely fast. The coordination between the nut-bearer and the vine-pulling teammate must be millisecond-perfect; any delay could lead to a failed trap and a lost granary.
The Calamity Meteor that appears now is empowered by the Source of Calamity, significantly increasing its stability. Players must unleash stronger attacks to shatter it.
When giant-sized, it spawns explosive wooden fences at each player's feet. Move away immediately.
While dragging a teammate, the Radish King generates sturdy thorn armor. While the blade-wielding small radishes can cut the vines, they cannot break the armor.

When the Phantom Nightmare changes forms, the number of nightmare rifts on the field increases, putting more pressure on teammates to rescue. Meanwhile, the Nightmare Butterflies that abduct players become much weaker and more fragile.

In the second phase, the walls rotate faster, and the Sky-Slayer Spirit locks onto each player, spawning three tracking energy orbs that persist in pursuit, severely hindering movement. The team must dodge the energy orbs while finding gaps in the walls to shatter the hidden Constellation Shadows.
The team must move in unison and transfer sequentially, efficiently utilizing every stone pillar within the limited time. Any member lagging behind may disrupt the rhythm and lead to casualties.

The Sky-Slayer Spirit returns to the center to channel star power, summoning five constellations that rotate around it. Players must quickly shatter all star nodes to interrupt the chant. Success causes the spirit to dissipate; failure results in a full-screen Starfall attack.
When the Brutal Tiger charges with its shield, the shield has its own durability. Players must focus fire to break it, or the final unavoidable red-light charge will deal devastating damage.

In addition to the original mechanics, an Elite Armor Rat appears, charging along a fixed route. If the nut-carrier is hit, the nut is dropped. A player must be assigned to intercept the elite and clear the rolling small rats, or the formation will easily be disrupted.
The Wood Fence King's attack power spikes during its giant form. The team must efficiently intercept and throw fire bombs; any delay will cause the survival space to shrink rapidly.

After charging, the Wanshu Hammer releases a full-screen shockwave. One player must quickly pick up a mechanical shield dropped on the field to block the attack, while other players must stay close behind the shield-bearer to avoid damage. The shockwave will erupt twice in succession; adjust your positioning accordingly.
The thorn armor covering the Wood Fence King's torso has become exceptionally tough, requiring more fire bombs to break.

The Sky-Slayer Spirit summons five hidden Constellation Shadows and drives four rotating starlight walls. The walls have gaps for escape; players must flexibly weave through these gaps to find and shatter all hidden Constellation Shadows.
Nightmare Ripples overflowing from the Nightmare Rift are spreading at an accelerated rate, rapidly eroding the already limited survival space.

The Blade-Slayer Spirit locks onto a player to charge, while the Halberd-Slayer Spirit activates a fire shield in the center of the arena. Players must lure the Blade-Slayer Spirit into crashing into the fire shield three times to break it; otherwise, the team will suffer massive full-screen damage.

The Armor Rat King summons multiple small armored rats to roll around and cause chaos. One carries a special nut; defeating it leaves the nut on the field. The King then pulls all players in and binds two with Resonance Vines (the bound are silenced and will be pulled back if they get too far apart). Other teammates must pick up the nut to lure the King into charging. The two connected by vines must pull in opposite directions to create a tripwire to trip the giant rat during its charge.

The Brutal Tiger raises its shield and locks onto a player for continuous charges. The target must adjust their position to avoid hitting teammates, while others can attack the Tiger's back. The final charge is a red-light skill that must be dodged.

Players must jump onto the stone pillars in time to avoid the ground flames. After the fire breath ends, the Scorching Fluff will enter an exhausted state—this is the best time to unleash full damage.

Before the Wanshu Hammer launches its full-screen attack, it summons two mechanical minions. One will attempt to grab the shield on the field. The team must prioritize focusing fire on the shield-bearing minion to reclaim the shield; otherwise, you will be unable to block the subsequent devastating full-screen attack.
The Blade-Slayer Spirit splits into four phantom clones that lock onto different players for a charge.
Players suffer significantly increased erosion from the Darkest Nightmare, and healing effects are greatly suppressed.
When dispatched to the Colorful Cloud Basin, gain 2 additional Wave-Boat Fruits.
Everything began with the War of God's Fall. Nuwa and Dijun clashed over the Miracle, leading to the fall of all gods. Before she vanished, Nuwa left behind prophecies and hopes for the future.
On the battlefield of ruin, heroes stand with you to launch a fierce assault against the powerful enemy.
As everyone was fighting, Qiansi leaped down from above. The power of the Divine Mark erupted from his body, strengthening his original shell and forming even more violent and powerful strength.
Mulan battles the "Heartless," only to be shocked by the very scar that once saved her. Aunt Li tearfully reveals the truth: "I was bitten while trying to save you..."

Mulan offers her sword as a sacrifice, performing the 'Blade Tempers the Setting Sun, Returning Geese Never Depart' stance. Entrusting her grief to the heroic spirits, only history and her departing silhouette remain where the purple light fades.

Inside the Tower of Heaven, Zhuang Zhou, who was guarding the Cloud Silkworm, was defeated by the combined efforts of Jiang Ziya and a mysterious figure in black. Jiang Ziya took the Cloud Silkworm core and left. Zhuang Zhou exhausted his own power to replace the Cloud Silkworm and take his place in the Tower of Heaven.
As you step into the cave, the ground shakes. Gan Si lets out a pained cry as he breaks free from the Cloud Root Pillar.

Under the witness of the stone statues, Hua Mulan uses military orders to awaken Li Xun's remaining will. Together, they sing the frontier song, executing demons with discipline. As the strings snap, humanity returns, leaving only the tragic echo of 'Warrior, do not return...'

You failed to stop Di Xin, and the world crumbled in his hands. The Primordial Priest blocked a fatal blow for you and sent you away from this world. As you parted, she gently said that this would not be the end of everything.
The heroes fight alongside you, but one by one they fall before the overwhelming power. They cleared the path for you and escorted you to Di Xin; you now face him carrying their will.
The Great Wall Garrison fights the monsters in blood. Li Xun's sacrifice ignites Hua Mulan's desperate resolve...

Master and Jiang Ziya fought. Qian Si appeared to persuade them to stop, but Jiang Ziya recognized him as his former student and killed him anyway. Master was furious, and Jiang Ziya, having regained his full power, severely injured everyone present. At the critical moment, Master used his body as a shield, sacrificing himself to save everyone. You and the others fell unconscious, and Jiang Ziya left in silence.
A strange black mist suddenly strikes, surrounding you and Qinglan. The source is none other than the Youying, who hasn't been seen for days...
Just as Qiansi was about to take you down with him, he discovered your academy crest. Recognizing you as a Jixia student, he regained his senses and saved you, falling into the abyss alone.

Just as you reached out to take the mark, a violent force of Conferred Gods surged into the arena, binding everyone. Jiang Ziya, the man in black, and Xingli descended from the sky. Master arrived, broke the bindings, and confronted Jiang Ziya in anger.
Li Xiaomiao wins a narrow victory through trickery, but Mulan sees through her sword style in three moves, causing her to lose in embarrassment and accidentally reveal her Guardian token.
Xingmang is excited about finding the mechanism core, but Wujiu's cannonballs are everywhere. After a blinding flash of fire, everything around seems to have gone still...
Kui attempts a sneak attack on Chenzang from behind, but is blocked by the Festival Fish Clan Chief...
When HP is below 60%, casting the third skill restores HP.
